create.name: Laura Lynne Jackson
create.bio:
Laura Lynne Jackson spent close to two decades teaching high school English before she began to work openly as a psychic medium, an ability she says she struggled with and played down for many years. She holds medium certifications from both Windbridge and the Forever Family Foundation, has taken part in research into mediumship and consciousness, and is a board member at the Rhine, the parapsychology institute that grew out of work at Duke University.

Her central teaching is that the people we love stay connected to us after death, and that everyone can learn to notice the signs, intuitions and guidance that come from what she calls the Other Side. She explores this in three books, The Light Between Us, Signs and Guided, and in talks, interviews and large group events. Her private readings are no longer open to new clients, so most people now meet her work through workshops in which participants practise exercises to develop their own intuitive and mediumistic senses and to work with what she calls a personal team of light. She lives in New York with her husband and three children.

books.title: The Light Between Us: Stories from Heaven. Lessons for the Living.
books.author: Laura Lynne Jackson
books.description: Her first book tells the story of how a schoolteacher came to accept her work as a medium, alongside accounts of readings and her time being tested by researchers. Its core message is that bonds of love carry on after death and can shape how we live now.

books.title: Signs: The Secret Language of the Universe
books.author: Laura Lynne Jackson
books.description: A practical book on noticing and reading the signs she believes loved ones and spirit guides send. Through many personal stories it suggests ways to ask for a sign and to trust what arrives.

books.title: Guided: The Secret Path to an Illuminated Life
books.author: Laura Lynne Jackson
books.description: Her 2025 book looks at how guidance from those who have died can point people towards their purpose. It uses stories and reflections to explore meaning, connection and what she calls an illuminated way of living.

courses.title: An Illuminated Life
courses.description: A large weekend retreat at Omega's Rhinebeck campus on meeting your guides and loved ones who have died. Through group exercises, including object reading, participants work on their own intuitive and mediumistic senses and on asking for clear signs.
courses.price: Member $465 USD, standard $515 USD (tuition; accommodation extra)
